messages.content: 你被給予一個包含各種變數的資料集，包括「年齡」、「收入」、「教育」、「性別」、「婚姻狀況」和「消費分數」。你想要根據其他變數來預測「消費分數」。請問你能否使用「run_linear_regression」函數建立一個線性迴歸模型，使用「年齡」、「收入」和「教育」作為預測變數，「消費分數」作為目標變數，而不對預測變數進行標準化？然後，你能否再次運行同一個函數，但這次對預測變數進行標準化？

function.name: run_linear_regression
function.description: Build a linear regression model using given predictor variables and a target variable. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

predictors.description: Array containing the names of predictor variables.

standardize.description: Option to apply standardization on the predictors. Defaults to False.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Can you use run_linear_regression to build a linear regression model with predictors age, income, education, target consumption score, without standardization? Then run again with standardization?" They want to see if we can call the function twice. We need to call the function with appropriate arguments. The function signature: run_linear_regression({predictors: string[], target: string, standardize?: boolean}). So first call: standardize default false. Second call: standardize true.

We need to produce calls to the function. According to guidelines, we should call the function via the "functions.run_linear_regression" tool. We need to output the function calls. The user wants us to do that. So we will produce two calls. The first call: predictors ["年齡","收入","教育"], target "消費分數", standardize omitted or false. The second call: same but standardize true.

We should output the calls in JSON format? The tool expects JSON. So we need to produce two calls. Usually we produce one call at a time. But we can produce two calls sequentially. The guidelines: "When calling a function, you must provide the arguments as a JSON object." So we need to produce two separate calls. We can produce them one after another. The assistant should respond with the function calls. The tool will handle them. So we produce:

First call: 
{
  "predictors": ["年齡","收入","教育"],
  "target": "消費分數"
}

Second call:
{
  "predictors": ["年齡","收入","教育"],
  "target": "消費分數",
  "standardize": true
}

We need to wrap each call in the function call format: "function": "run_linear_regression", "arguments": {...}. So we produce two calls. The assistant should output them. Let's do that.
